package rulefixtures

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"os"
)

// scenario for migration_runner_and_api_server_bootstrap_coupled: One startup path that always runs migrations and serves traffic together.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

func applyMigrations(dsn string) error {
	fmt.Printf("running migrations on %s\n", dsn)
	return nil
}

func main() {
	dsn := os.Getenv("DATABASE_URL")
	if dsn == "" {
		dsn = "postgres://localhost:5432/mydb"
	}

	if err := applyMigrations(dsn); err != nil {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("migration failure: %v", err))
	}

	fmt.Println("migrations complete, starting server")

	http.HandleFunc("/health", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
		w.Write([]byte("healthy"))
	})

	fmt.Println("listening on :8080")
	if err := http.ListenAndServe(":8080", nil); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
